name: communara-store-app
description: Communara for the App Store and Google Play. Wraps the Communara web app (bundled for offline use) with native speech that can play through the phone speaker even when headphones are connected.

scripts.add-platforms: npx cap add ios && npx cap add android && node scripts/apply-native.js
scripts.sync: npm run copy-web && npx cap sync && node scripts/apply-native.js
